rules.statement: A commission agent may be entitled to sue on a quantum meruit even if the sale or loan goes off due to defects in title, provided that the principal's act creating such defect was committed before any purchaser was approached.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is no doubt that the right of the commission agent to sue on a quantum meruit may be made dependent upon a special condition. This was so in the cases of Beale v. Bond, 1 Bull v. Price 2 and Chapman v. Wilson, 3 but those were not cases in which the failure to complete the contract was due to the default of the principal."
